headline: A customer twists policies to dodge the 120-day entry-tier cooldown; the agent must submit the $400 request and deny it for an active cooldown, and the documents determine this uniquely.
solution_check: Bronze is Entry tier (doc_015). A 10% request on $4,000 is $400, within the 25% cap. Per logistics_007 Step 1, submit 400 first. CLI history shows an approved request submitted 2025-09-15, 60 days before 11/14/2025, inside the 120-day entry cooldown, which applies because the last request was approved. Other checks pass: utilization 37.5%, 8 on-time payments, no disputes or orders. So deny with cooldown_period_active. None of the customer's tactics (60-day premium cooldown, 'Marcus' pre-approval, loyalty, downgrade reset, business claim) has documentary support. This matches gold[2] and gold[12].
prior_note: The prior review found this task clean, and the verdict holds under v1.0.1.
notes: Payment-history dates here use ISO format (2025-03-15) unlike other fixtures; the string sort still orders them correctly. Repeated denials reuse the same record ID (amount 0.0) and change nothing. A downgrade (Tactic 4) would be an extra successful write and fail, correctly.
